headlines: ASTS Stock Slides After-Hours As SpaceX Snags Grain Spectrum, Analyst Who Called The Deal Says Ligado Is Next
gappers.catalyst_detail: Stocktwits/TradingView headline: ASTS slid after-hours as SpaceX won Grain Spectrum assets; the analyst who called it says Ligado spectrum is next. Competing D2D spectrum acquisitions threaten ASTS's positioning. Background: stock +~68% over prior 30 days, ~$3.9B cash (Apr 2026). Article date not verified.
gappers.why: Rival (SpaceX) locking up spectrum raises competitive/valuation risk for a stock that ran +68% in 30d; profit-taking on a momentum name.
gappers.impact: Volume 1.05M, gap -6.9% off a big run; reads as headline-driven pullback with further downside if Ligado also goes to SpaceX. No peer read-through verified.
gappers.horizon: SHORT_TERM, headline-driven spectrum-competition fear; no durable thesis change confirmed.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Gap is down; long-only strategy, no short. A dip-buy would need a stop within 7-10% and 2:1 R:R toward the pre-gap $56.94 (~+7%) fails 2:1 at a 10% trail; would displace any weaker holding and use 1 of 3 weekly trades. Research only.
